study_method_findings.TITLE: Village survey Medium and large mammal survey data
study_method_findings.observation_method: Fixed/periodic infrared sensor camera sampling from Japanese nationwide monitoring
study_method_findings.reported_coordinate_precision: Authors state detailed coordinates withheld and public study coordinates provided only to first decimal place for conservation reasons; camera locations individually not published
study_method_findings.why_not_admissible: Coarsened site georeferencing cannot establish individual camera placements relative to a precise GSHHG island shoreline or independent donor geometry; nationwide camera network not source-proven as one archipelago

study_method_findings.TITLE: Surface of the earth wandering beetles survey data
study_method_findings.observation_method: Pitfall-trap sampling of ground-active beetles in forest and grassland plots across Japanese monitoring sites
study_method_findings.why_not_admissible: Different taxonomic/measurement domain than 373; national plot frame is not validated as one archipelago with biologically measurable cross-island donor movements

pairwise_methods_evaluation.source_record_conflict_note: Source generic SUMMARY_METHODS labels differ from detailed author METHODS (e.g., 373 detailed infrared cameras; 375 detailed pitfall traps); use methods text not summary label for biological method inference
pairwise_methods_evaluation.evidence_ceiling: The two earlier GSHHG-positive STUDY_IDs are geometry-only candidates, not two genuine independent archipelago tests of structural island source/colonization mechanisms.

decision.next_action: Stop claiming the BioTIME 33 or 2 constitute a global independent island mechanism sample; retain general global temporal community sampled detection result separately. For island ecology use independently surveyed oceanic/continental island checklists with a validated stable island identity and documented temporal detection, or a genuinely observed movement/establishment dataset.
